info.title: Atrium integration API
info.description: Core-only restricted projection for home-mcp. No media bytes, URLs, filesystem paths or admin capabilities. Successful results use Cache-Control: no-store. Integration requests are bounded to five seconds; 600/minute, burst 100 per principal.

IssueCommand.description: Kind-specific validation: navigate dashboard accepts no collection; navigate photos requires collection; show requires only photo_id; refresh requires empty payload. The same principal and operation_id reuse the command without restarting TTL. New IDs must be within -24 hours / +5 minutes; persisted IDs remain queryable for seven days.
